module.Title: Inspect Every Zone
module.Teaching: for and range() repeat a block a known number of times. range(1, 6) produces 1 through 5.
module.ExampleCode:
for pump in range(1, 4):
    print(f"Checking pump {pump}")
module.TargetCode:
for zone in range(1, 6):
    print(f"Checking zone {zone}")
module.FillStarter:
for zone in range(___, ___):
    print(f"Checking zone {zone}")
module.PredictionQuestion: Why is the stop value 6 when there are five zones?
module.PredictionExplanation: range excludes its stop value, so range(1, 6) ends at 5.
module.BrokenCode:
for zone in range(1, 5):
print(f"Checking zone {zone}")
module.DebugPrompt: Use a stop value of 6 and indent the loop body.
module.RecallPrompt: Rebuild the five-zone inspection loop. Use these exact identifiers: f, print, range. Use these exact values: 1, 6, "Checking zone {zone}".
module.TransferPrompt: Inspect pumps 1 through 3. Use these exact identifiers: f, print, pump, range. Use these exact values: 4, "Checking pump {pump}".
module.TransferCode:
for pump in range(1, 4):
    print(f"Checking pump {pump}")
module.PreviewMessage: The inspection routine can now visit every facility zone.
